{"id":1850473946,"question_id":3815,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1765221771,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"18 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1850473946/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Sum of Largest Prime Substrings","memory":"9.4 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    bool isPrime(ll n) \n    {\n        if (n < 2) return false; \n\n        for (ll i = 2; i*i <= n; i++)\n        {\n           if (n % i == 0) return false;\n        }    \n        return true;\n    }\n\n    ll sumOfLargestPrimes(const string &s) {\n        vector<ll>primes;\n        for(ll i = 0; i < s.size(); i++) \n        {\n            ll temp = 0;\n            for(ll j = i; j < s.size(); j++) \n            {\n                temp = temp * 10 + (s[j] - '0');\n                if (isPrime(temp)) \n                {\n                    primes.emplace_back(temp);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        sort(primes.begin(), primes.end());\n        primes.erase(unique(primes.begin(), primes.end()), primes.end());\n        ll m = primes.size();\n        if (m < 3) return accumulate(primes.begin(), primes.end(),0ll);\n        return primes[m - 1] + primes[m - 2] + primes[m - 3];\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"sum-of-largest-prime-substrings","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1288}
